v01.raw_sql: SELECT a.assignment_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM journey_events e WHERE e.assignment_id=a.assignment_id AND e.event_type='booking' AND julianday(e.event_at)>=julianday(a.assigned_at) AND julianday(e.event_at)<=julianday(a.assigned_at)+28) AS booked,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM journey_events e WHERE e.assignment_id=a.assignment_id AND e.event_type='test_drive_completed' AND julianday(e.event_at)>=julianday(a.assigned_at) AND julianday(e.event_at)<=julianday(a.assigned_at)+28) AS completed,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM journey_events e WHERE e.assignment_id=a.assignment_id AND e.event_type='opt_out' AND julianday(e.event_at)>=julianday(a.assigned_at) AND julianday(e.event_at)<=julianday(a.assigned_at)+28) AS opted_out FROM assignments a
v01.stored_view_sql:
CREATE VIEW experiment_outcomes AS
SELECT a.assignment_id,a.experiment_id,a.customer_id,a.arm,a.assigned_at,c.dealer_id,c.model_id,c.lead_source,
MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='booking' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked,
MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='test_drive_completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed,
MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='opt_out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opted_out
FROM assignments a JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
LEFT JOIN journey_events e ON e.assignment_id=a.assignment_id
AND julianday(e.event_at)>=julianday(a.assigned_at)
AND julianday(e.event_at)<=julianday(a.assigned_at)+28
GROUP BY a.assignment_id

srm.role: 배정 진단; 0.001은 검수 경보 기준이며 원계획 성공조건 아님

v01.financial_scope_note: 기본 A/B에는 계약/매출/기여액이 없어 비용만 산출한다. 손익 추정은 v03만 수행하며 v01 매출을 꾸며내지 않는다.

v03.raw_sql: SELECT a.assignment_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.assignment_id=a.assignment_id AND e.event_type='booking' AND e.event_day>=a.assigned_day AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+28) AS booked,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.assignment_id=a.assignment_id AND e.event_type='test_drive_completed' AND e.event_day>=a.assigned_day AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+28) AS completed,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.assignment_id=a.assignment_id AND e.event_type='consent_withdrawn' AND e.event_day>=a.assigned_day AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+28) AS withdrawn,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.assignment_id=a.assignment_id AND e.event_type='contract_signed' AND e.event_day>=a.assigned_day AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+180) AS contracted FROM assignments a
v03.stored_view_sql:
CREATE VIEW outcomes AS SELECT a.assignment_id,a.customer_id,a.arm,a.assigned_day,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='booking' AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked_28,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='test_drive_completed' AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_28,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='consent_withdrawn' AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+28 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withdrawn_28,
 MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_type='contract_signed' AND e.event_day<=a.assigned_day+180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contracted_180
 FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN events e USING(assignment_id) GROUP BY a.assignment_id

plan_hash_diagnosis.conclusion: 현재 LF 직렬화와 과거 CRLF 직렬화의 차이로 정확히 설명됨. 정확 바이트 불일치는 보존.

limitations: 합성 데이터 및 교육용 비용; 실제 OEM 매출/회계 손익 검증 아님.
개인 독립, 고정 관측, 군집/간섭 없음에 조건부. 가구/지점 독립성을 DB 고유성만으로 입증하지 않음.
철회는 미보정 탐색. 사전 안전 비열등성 설계와 한계가 없어 정식 안전 통과/실패를 계산하지 않음.
손익 Welch는 미보정 탐색이며 계약/완료의 고객별 결합과 고정 비용 가정에 조건부.
기본 A/B에는 계약이 없으므로 비용만 계산; v03의 계약 수익을 기본 A/B에 대입하지 않음.
기존 분석 코드 함수를 가져오거나 실행하지 않았으며 기존 소스/책/DB/이전 결과는 수정하지 않음.
검수 스크립트 내부 재계산은 기존 분석 코드와 별개이나 별도 사람 검수 또는 외부 검증을 뜻하지 않음.
